findings.counterexample: A child emits a non-UTF-8 byte such as 0xff on stdout or stderr. The file receives the UTF-8 encoding of the replacement character because result.stdout/result.stderr are decoded strings, while byteCount and digest describe the original Buffer. A raw one-byte stream becomes three file bytes. This is a static counterexample; it was not executed in this review.
